title: Scratchpad
dictationHelp: Click in the note editor, then use your usual Handy dictation shortcut. Dictation is pasted at the cursor. Edits save automatically after a short pause.
historyLimit: Keeps the original and the 49 most recent revisions. Restoring creates a new revision.
deleteConfirm: Delete this note, its versions and its chat? This cannot be undone.
providerHelp: Uses your configured AI provider and sends this note to it. Review the result before applying. Manage saved prompts in post-processing settings.
stalePreview: The note changed after this preview. Generate a new preview before applying.
chatHelp: Answers use the current saved note and recent chat. Your configured AI provider receives this context. Chat does not edit the note. The 40 most recent messages are kept.
question: Question about this note
conflictHelp: Your draft is still in the editor. Save a copy, or load the latest saved revision as a base and explicitly save your draft over it.
saveCopy: Save draft as a new note
recoveredDraft: Recovered an unsaved draft from this device. Automatic saving is paused. Review it, then save now or save a new copy. Its original revision is retained so another edit cannot be overwritten silently.
backupFailed: The local draft backup could not be read or written. Keep this editor open until Save now succeeds. Copy your text somewhere safe before leaving.
importTooLarge: Choose a Markdown file smaller than 2 MB.
